tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urine analysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), marked leukocyturia, positive nitrites, and hematuria, indicating a urinary tract infection. Glucosuria is present, possibly suggesting hyperglycemia or diabetes. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation, assessment for diabetes, and prompt treatment of UTI.
